result.topic_en: End of §5 and start of §6 of Riemann's Habilitationsschrift. It summarises the necessary and sufficient conditions for the existence of the definite integral and their modification for the extended (improper) integral. It then introduces functions that are discontinuous infinitely often in every interval.
